# Write-free e2e: explicit exit-code contract (Appendix / diagnostic.Exit*).
# cwd: $WORK (fresh). No FS mutation expected.
#
# Exit 130 (cancellation) is deterministically covered at the unit layer
# (internal/cli/surface_test.go TestRootExitCodes; internal/cli/generate_test.go
# cancel matrix) rather than here: testscript's exec has no portable way to
# both deliver a real SIGINT to the subprocess at the right moment AND read
# back its exact numeric exit code (background+kill+wait only exposes
# success/failure, not the code) without reimplementing test-internal
# process-management. bead go-foundry-cli-wet.2.6.

# --- exit 0: success paths ---
assert_exit_code 0 foundry version
assert_exit_code 0 foundry version --output json
assert_exit_code 0 foundry validate --spec examples/minimal-cli.toml
assert_exit_code 0 foundry validate --spec examples/minimal-cli.toml --output json
assert_exit_code 0 foundry plan --spec examples/minimal-cli.toml
assert_exit_code 0 foundry catalog list
assert_exit_code 0 foundry catalog show core

# --- exit 2: usage errors ---
# Unknown/conflicting global flags (usage.invalid).
assert_exit_code 2 foundry version --quiet --verbose
stderr 'usage.invalid'
assert_exit_code 2 foundry version --output yaml
stderr 'usage.invalid'
assert_exit_code 2 foundry version --offline
stderr 'unknown flag|usage.invalid'

# Invalid specification content (spec.* — usage class).
assert_exit_code 2 foundry validate --spec examples/invalid-unknown-field.toml
stderr 'spec.unknown_field'
assert_exit_code 2 foundry validate --spec examples/invalid-bad-profile.toml
stderr 'resolve.unknown_profile'

# Missing required flag / nonexistent spec path.
assert_exit_code 2 foundry validate --spec does-not-exist.toml
stderr 'usage.invalid'

# Unknown subcommand.
assert_exit_code 2 foundry bogus-subcommand

# --- exit 1: internal/catalog-class failures (not usage) ---
# Unknown catalog unit id is catalog.invalid, not a usage error (exit 1).
assert_exit_code 1 foundry catalog show does-not-exist-unit-id
stderr 'catalog.invalid'
